title: Clarified the admin database panel access path
points: The public Database docs now explain the split between the public corpus health summary and the admin-only operator matrix at /admin/data-quality.
The admin Database Health page now labels itself as the operator view, links back to the public Database docs, and no longer displays backend deployment identifiers in the page chrome.
The admin database panel remains protected for admin accounts and is intentionally accessed by direct URL or trace-viewer context rather than the main app navigation.
